cells.gaps: No count of the AI UniPod's GPUs, and no count of its users beyond the November 2026 residency, has been found.
cells.note: UNDP says its EDGE initiative provides high-performance GPUs at the AI UniPod, so AI computing is in service. On 9 November 2026 a residency opened there for 51 startup founders from 12 African countries, so its users are counted.
